was a winter-themed map, with multiple trees, lampposts and snow mounds scattered around the map. It was a fortified research facility. A small pond could be seen in the middle of the map. Near the end of the map, multiple brick walls with lights could be seen, alongside military hangars in the mountains. Several pipes and listening beacons could be seen. The entire research facility was located in a canyon.
